# `mise tasks graph`

- **Usage**: `mise tasks graph [FLAGS]`
- **Effect**: read-only
- **Source code**: [`src/cli/tasks/graph.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tasks/graph.rs)

[experimental] Inspect the workspace project graph

## Flags

### `-J --json`

Output the project graph as JSON

### `--explain`

Explain provider attribution for inferred projects and tasks

### `--no-header`

Do not print table headers
